Sheet.AskGM: Ask the DM to assign you a character. It will show up here automatically.

HP.Label: Hit points
HP.TempNotHigher: You already have that much temporary HP or more. Temporary HP doesn't stack.

Sheet.TapToRoll: Tap any value to roll it. The result goes to chat.

Actions.Empty: Your character has no equipped weapons, spells, features or consumables to use.
Actions.TapToUse: Tap Attack, Damage or the DC to roll (it shows in the TV chat). Hold Attack for advantage or disadvantage, and Damage to choose normal or critical. Tap the name to read the description.
Actions.TemplatePlaced: Area placed on your token on the map. The DM can move or rotate it.
Actions.TemplateNoScene: There is no active scene to place the area on.
Actions.TemplateNoPermission: You don't have permission to place areas on the map. Ask the DM.
Actions.TemplateFailed: The area could not be placed on the map.
Actions.EndCast: End this casting: the next button casts it again
Actions.AlreadyCast: {name} is already cast. To cast it again, tap “Cast ✕” on its row.
Actions.PassiveHint: Passive: nothing to use. Whatever it adds is already included in your rolls if dnd5e automates it.
Actions.SummonPlaced: Creature placed next to your token on the map. The GM can move it.

Combat.NoneHint: When the DM starts a combat, the initiative order and your turn will show up here.
Combat.YourTurnHint: Pick your action, bonus action and movement in the Combat tab. When you're done, tap “End turn”.
Combat.YourTurnDying: You're at 0 HP: roll your death saving throw, then end your turn.
Combat.NotStartedHint: Roll your initiative while the DM sets up the combat.
Combat.NotInCombat: Your character isn't in this combat. Ask the DM to add your token.

Death.Title: Death saving throws
Death.Hint: 10 or higher is a success. A natural 20 brings you back with 1 HP; a natural 1 counts as two failures.
Death.Stable: You're stable. No need to roll anymore.

Use.Error: {name} could not be used: {error}. Tell the DM (details are in their console).

Hud.Title: Your turn
Hud.AlreadyUsed: You already used it this turn. If the DM allows it, you can still use something.
Hud.OpportunityHint: When an enemy leaves your reach, attack it with your reaction.
Hud.Empty: You have nothing of this kind.
Hud.Hint: Tap a block to see your options. Tap a portrait above to mark it as a target.

Result.DamageHint: Tap “Damage” on the row to roll it.

Picker.One: Tap who you're aiming at. It shows on the TV.
Picker.Many: Pick up to {max} targets and confirm.
Picker.ManualHint: Tap to mark or unmark. They show on the TV.
Picker.Full: At most {max} targets. Unmark one first.
Picker.Empty: There are no visible creatures in the TV scene.

dodge.Name: Dodge
dodge.Chat: Until the start of their next turn, attacks against this character have disadvantage (if they can see the attacker), and they have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

dash.Name: Dash
dash.Chat: Gains extra movement equal to their speed this turn.

disengage.Name: Disengage
disengage.Chat: Their movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

help.Name: Help
help.Chat: Help: an ally's next attack against the target (or an ally's next check) has advantage.

ready.Name: Ready
ready.Chat: Readies an action: they'll take it with their reaction when the stated trigger happens.

Rest.Title: Rest
Rest.OnlyGM: In this game, rests are started by the GM.

Move.TurnHint: The count resets when your turn starts.
Move.FreeHint: Outside combat you can move freely.
Move.DashHint: You used Dash: your speed is doubled this turn.
Move.OverHint: You've used all your speed (Dash?). The GM decides.
Move.Hint: Each tap moves your token one square on the TV.
Move.NoToken: Your character has no token in the TV's scene. Ask the GM to place it.
Move.NoScene: The GM hasn't activated a scene yet.

Reason.TokenLocked: The GM has locked your token.
Reason.NotYourTurn: Wait for your turn to move.
Reason.NoDiagonal: Diagonal movement isn't allowed on this map.
Reason.GMNotViewing: The GM isn't viewing this scene in Foundry.
Reason.NoGM: The GM isn't connected: they're needed to move.
Reason.NoResponse: The GM isn't responding. Try again.

Inventory.CurrencyHint: Tap a coin to type the new amount.
Inventory.AttunementFull: You already have {max} attuned items, the maximum. Unattune another one first.

Load.encumbered: Encumbered: your speed drops by 10 feet.
Load.heavy: Heavily encumbered: speed −20 feet and disadvantage on STR, DEX and CON checks, attacks and saves.
Load.over: You are carrying more than you can lift.

Inventory.Hint: Circle: equip or unequip. Sun: attune. Tap an item to see its description.

Notes.Placeholder: Write anything you want to remember: clues, names, quests…
Notes.SaveFailed: Could not save. Check the connection.
Notes.NoBiography: Your character has no biography yet. It is written in the normal Foundry sheet.

Exit.Button: Return to the normal Foundry interface
Exit.Title: Return to the normal interface?
Exit.Content: The page will reload with the normal Foundry interface on this device. You can switch back with the "Mobile view" button.

Connection.Hint: Reconnecting to the game… Check that your phone is still on the Wi-Fi. Your notes are safe.

Install.Title: Add to Home Screen
Install.Installed: You are already using it as an app from your home screen. ✓
Install.IOS: In Safari, tap Share (the square with the up arrow) and then Add to Home Screen. You will need to log in again the first time.
Install.Android: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu (top right) and tap Add to Home screen or Install app.

LargeText.Name: Large text
LargeText.Hint: Makes all text and buttons in the view bigger.

KeepAwake.Name: Keep screen on
KeepAwake.Hint: The screen won't turn off by itself while the view is open. Uses a bit more battery.
KeepAwake.Unsupported: This browser doesn't allow it (it needs HTTPS, like The Forge, and a recent browser).

PhoneMusic.Name: Music on the phone
PhoneMusic.Hint: Music normally plays only on the TV. Turn this on to hear it here too (uses data and battery).

Enabled.Name: Enable mobile view
Enabled.Hint: Players joining from a phone or small screen see the BHD Companion mobile view instead of the normal interface. Does not affect the GM.

ForceAll.Name: Force mobile view on any device (testing)
ForceAll.Hint: Shows the mobile view to every player, even on a computer. Useful for testing. Does not affect the GM.

ShowEnemyHealth.Name: Show enemy health status
ShowEnemyHealth.Hint: In the phone's Combat tab, players see an approximate status for each enemy (Healthy, Hurt, Bloodied, Near death), never the numbers. Uncheck to hide it.

ShowAttackResult.Name: Tell players whether their attack hits
ShowAttackResult.Hint: In the phone's combat HUD, after an attack it shows “Hit!” or “Miss” for each target (never their AC). Uncheck it if you'd rather announce it yourself.

LockMovement.Name: Lock movement from phones
LockMovement.Hint: Nobody can move their token from the phone's Move tab (for example, during a dialogue scene).

MoveOutsideTurn.Name: In combat, allow moving outside your own turn
MoveOutsideTurn.Hint: Normally, in combat each player can only move their token from the phone during their turn. Check this to always allow it.

FollowMoves.Name: Follow tokens moved from a phone
FollowMoves.Hint: On this screen (for example, the TV), the map centers on the token a player moves from their phone.

ViewMode.Name: BHD Companion view
ViewMode.Hint: On this device. Automatic: mobile view on phones and tablets (including iPad), normal Foundry on computers and TVs. You can also force it with ?bhd=mobile or ?bhd=normal at the end of the link. The GM always sees normal Foundry.

PreferNormal.Name: Use the normal interface on this device
PreferNormal.Hint: When checked, this browser will not show the mobile view even on a phone.

Status.Title: Status
Status.EndConcentrationContent: Stop concentrating on {name}? The spell ends.
Status.ConcentrationReplaced: You stop concentrating on {name}: you can only concentrate on one spell at a time.

Save.Title: Roll a saving throw!
Save.AutoRoll: If you don't roll within {seconds} s, it rolls by itself.

Midi.TapToUse: Tap Attack, Cast or Use: choose who, and the DM's PC does everything with Midi QOL (attack and, if it hits, damage). Here you see whether it hit and how much damage it did; the card shows up in the TV chat. Press and hold for advantage, disadvantage or the spell level. Tap the name to read the description.

Reason.NoGM: No DM is connected: {name} can't be used. Ask the DM to open Foundry.
Reason.NoSocketlib: The socketlib module is missing (Midi QOL needs it): {name} can't be used. Tell the DM.
Reason.GMOutdated: The DM's PC has an old version of BHD Companion. Ask the DM to reload Foundry (F5).
Reason.NotOwner: You don't own this character: the DM can't use {name} for you.
Reason.NotFound: The DM can't find {name} on your character. Try again in a moment.
Reason.NoMidi: Midi QOL isn't ready on the DM's PC: {name} can't be used.
Reason.GMNotViewing: The DM's PC is looking at another scene: ask them to go back to the TV scene to use {name}.
Reason.Cancelled: {name} didn't finish (no slots or uses, cancelled or it took too long). Check the chat.
Reason.Timeout: The DM didn't answer in time for {name}. Check that their Foundry is still open.
Reason.Error: {name} couldn't be used on the DM's PC: {error}

Reaction.Title: Reaction!
Reaction.NotUsed: {name} couldn't be used. Check the chat.

Spells.PrepareFull: {name} already has {value} of {max} spells prepared. Unprepare another one first.
Spells.Hint: Tap a spell to read all of it. Tap the circles of each level to spend or recover slots by hand. The buttons on the right work the same as in Actions.

Place.Title: Place area
Place.SelfHint: It comes out of your character: you can only rotate it.
Place.OutOfRange: It can't go any farther: out of the spell's range.
Place.GMPlaced: The DM placed the area of {name}.

Reason.NoToken: Your token isn't in the TV scene: the area of {name} can't be placed.
Reason.NoArea: dnd5e couldn't prepare the area of {name}.
Reason.Expired: Placing the area of {name} already ended. Cast it again.

Place.GMContent: {user} has been placing the area of {name} for a minute. You can place it yourself with the mouse (click to place, wheel to rotate).

Conditions.blinded: You can't see. You fail checks that require sight. Your attacks have disadvantage and attacks against you have advantage.
Conditions.charmed: You can't attack or harm the charmer. The charmer has advantage on social checks against you.
Conditions.deafened: You can't hear. You fail checks that require hearing.
Conditions.exhaustion: Each level gives −2 to your d20 tests (attacks, checks and saves) and −5 feet of speed. A long rest removes one level. At level 6, you die.
Conditions.exhaustionLegacy: Level 1: disadvantage on ability checks. 2: speed halved. 3: disadvantage on attacks and saves. 4: hit point maximum halved. 5: speed 0. 6: death. A long rest removes one level.
Conditions.frightened: Disadvantage on checks and attacks while you can see the source of your fear. You can't willingly move closer to it.
Conditions.grappled: Your speed is 0. Disadvantage on attacks against anyone except the grappler. The grappler can drag you.
Conditions.incapacitated: You can't take actions, bonus actions or reactions, or speak. Your concentration breaks. Disadvantage on initiative.
Conditions.invisible: No one can see you. Advantage on initiative and on your attacks; attacks against you have disadvantage (unless they can see you some other way).
Conditions.paralyzed: You're incapacitated and your speed is 0. You fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against you have advantage and any hit within 5 feet is a critical hit.
Conditions.petrified: You're stone: incapacitated, speed 0, you fail Strength and Dexterity saves, resist all damage and are immune to poison. Attacks against you have advantage.
Conditions.poisoned: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Conditions.prone: You're on the ground: you can only crawl or stand up (costs half your speed). Your attacks have disadvantage. Against you: advantage within 5 feet, disadvantage from farther away.
Conditions.restrained: Your speed is 0. Your attacks and Dexterity saves have disadvantage. Attacks against you have advantage.
Conditions.stunned: You're incapacitated. You fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against you have advantage.
Conditions.unconscious: You're incapacitated, prone and drop what you hold. Speed 0, you fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against you have advantage and any hit within 5 feet is a critical hit.
Conditions.surprised: You were caught off guard: disadvantage on your initiative roll.
Conditions.bleeding: You're bleeding: you lose hit points until you're healed or the wound is stopped. The DM will tell you how much.
Conditions.burning: You're on fire: you take 1d4 fire damage at the start of each turn. Use an action to put it out (you fall prone).
Conditions.cursed: You're under a curse. The DM will tell you what it does.
Conditions.diseased: You have a disease. The DM will tell you its effects.
Conditions.dehydration: You lack water: you gain exhaustion levels until you drink.
Conditions.malnutrition: You lack food: you gain exhaustion levels until you eat.
Conditions.suffocation: You can't breathe: once you run out of breath, you gain an exhaustion level at the end of each turn.
Conditions.falling: You're falling. When you land you take 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet (max 20d6) and fall prone.
Conditions.silenced: You can't speak: you can't cast spells with a verbal component.
Conditions.transformed: Your form changed (for example Wild Shape or Polymorph): your statistics may be different.
Conditions.dodging: Until your next turn, attacks against you have disadvantage and you have advantage on Dexterity saves.
Conditions.ethereal: You're on the Ethereal Plane: you can't affect or be affected by the normal world (with some exceptions).
Conditions.flying: You're flying. If you fall prone or your speed drops to 0, you fall.
Conditions.hovering: You're hovering: you don't fall even if knocked prone.
Conditions.hiding: You're hidden: others don't know where you are and you have advantage on your next attack. It ends if you make noise, attack or are found.
Conditions.marked: You're marked by an effect (for example Hunter's Mark or Hex).
Conditions.sleeping: You're asleep: unconscious until you take damage or someone wakes you.
Conditions.stable: You're stable at 0 HP: no more death saves. You regain 1 HP after 1d4 hours.
Conditions.coverHalf: Half cover: +2 to your AC and Dexterity saves.
Conditions.coverThreeQuarters: Three-quarters cover: +5 to your AC and Dexterity saves.
Conditions.coverTotal: Total cover: you can't be targeted directly by attacks or spells.
Conditions.bloodied: You have half your hit points or fewer.

Enchant.NoItems: No item in your inventory meets this enchantment's requirements.
Enchant.Full: You already enchanted as many items as allowed. Remove one to choose another.
